skills.name: Basic fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting pure proper or improper fractions with like denominators.

skills.name: Fraction conversion
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed number subtraction
skills.definition: Separately subtracting the integer whole parts and the fraction parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping a whole unit from the integer part to the fraction part when the fraction subtraction yields a negative result.

skills.name: Simplifying/reducing
skills.definition: Simplifying a fraction to its lowest terms or converting a fraction with a zero value to its integer form.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed Number Operations
skills.definition: Managing and separating calculations for whole numbers and fractional parts in mixed numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: Borrowing from a whole number to add to the fractional part when the minuend's fraction is smaller than the subtrahend's.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing final fractional terms to their lowest terms or converting fractions to whole numbers.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of the operands independently from the fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerator of the subtrahend from the numerator of the minuend while keeping the denominator constant.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: Regroup 1 or more wholes into equivalent fraction parts when the fraction subtraction results in a negative value.

skills.name: Simplify representation
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to its lowest terms or convert it to a clean integer format.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions with identical denominators where the first numerator is greater than or equal to the second.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominators
skills.definition: Determining the Least Common Denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Performing subtraction on the integer or whole-number parts of mixed numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping from a whole number to add to the fraction part when the fractional difference is negative.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the resulting fraction to its lowest/simplest terms.

skills.name: Find Common Denominators
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Separating and subtracting whole numbers and fractional parts in mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from Whole Number
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from the whole number part to resolve a negative fractional difference during subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reducing the final fractional result to its lowest terms or converting fraction-only results to integers.

skills.name: Subtract Pure Fractions
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions directly when there are no whole number components in the original problem.
